long_description:
Newcastle, get ready for the ultimate Halloween party! 🔥🕸️

Par-Desi Party UK brings you a spooktacular night of Bollywood, Punjabi and South Indian music, combining desi beats, spooky vibes and non-stop dancefloor energy under one roof!

🎧 Two Rooms. Two Vibes. One Epic Night!

🔥 Room 1 – Bollywood & Punjabi

Dance to your favourite Bollywood hits and Punjabi party anthems.

💥 Room 2 – South Indian Music

Get ready for mass beats from Tamil, Malayalam, Telugu and Kannada music.

🎃 Event Details

📅 Date: 28th October

⏰ Time: 10:30 PM – 3:00 AM

📍 Venue: World HQ, Newcastle upon Tyne, NE1 6UF

👻 Halloween Dress-Up & Best Costume Prize!

🏆 BEST COSTUME WINS A SPECIAL PRIZE! 🎃🔥

🕸️ Newcastle, Let’s Make Halloween Legendary!

Gather your squad, plan your costumes and get ready for a night of killer beats, desi vibes and unforgettable memories.

🎟️ Book your tickets now and get ready to own the dancefloor this Halloween!

📸 PHOTO & FILMING NOTICE

By entering the event, you consent to being photographed and filmed for promotional purposes. If you do not wish to be featured, please contact @pardesipartyuk with your photo or description and we will arrange removal where possible.

Follow @pardesiparty on Instagram or our Whatsapp community for regular updates 📢
